description: REQUIRES prior fourinsure__session__login call with same account_link_id. Get certificate application history detail. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

cvrc_no.description: Certificate application receipt number (증명서 접수번호). Obtain from certificate.history.list.

group_cvrc_no.description: Group receipt number (그룹 접수번호). Optional; omit unless the history row carries one.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
